windows_hosted_proof.policy: The exact hosted Windows installer must install silently on a fresh runner, and the installer, installed application, and uninstaller must each have a valid Scott Converse Authenticode signature and timestamp. The receipt installer hash must match SHA256SUMS.

macos_preflight.note: This local preflight proves the merged v0.3.5 code and unsigned Gatekeeper path. DMG container bytes are not reproducible, so the release workflow separately smoke-tests the exact hosted DMG and binds that hosted receipt hash to SHA256SUMS.

linux_hosted_proof.policy: The exact hosted Debian package must be built on Ubuntu 22.04, installed on a fresh runner, launched under Xvfb with an isolated app-data directory and Ollama forced absent, and prove database initialization plus bundled browser-extension and prompt resources. The receipt package hash must match SHA256SUMS.
